headline.purpose: Section heads and the review drive title.

title.purpose: Roadbook box numbers and stage names.

note.purpose: Roadbook box notes and state lines.

live-text.purpose: Every tripmeter text element, 20 arcmin or more at 1 m.

live-digits.purpose: Tripmeter digit banks only, 40 arcmin or more at 1 m.

motion.name: swipe
motion.purpose: The marker-yellow swipe landing on a selected box; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Button
components.description: Square ink-bordered button; inverts on hover in 1 step.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 7px 14px 5px; border: 2px solid #111417; background: #F5F7F7; color: #111417; font: 800 16px Overpass, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #111417; color: #F5F7F7; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #111417; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Uppercase label in a 1px ink box.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font: 800 13px/1.5 Overpass, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #111417; padding: 1px 7px 0; color: #111417; background: #F5F7F7; }

components.name: Citation chip
components.description: Source, signal, window, and stat of 1 citation; context citations dashed gray.
components.css: .ds-cite { display: inline-block; font: 400 13px/1.4 Overpass, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1, 'zero' 1; border: 1px solid #111417; padding: 2px 7px 1px; color: #111417; } .ds-cite b { font-weight: 800; }

components.name: Device token field
components.description: Square 2px ink field; the only input, parked views only.
components.css: .ds-input { font: 400 20px Overpass, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; padding: 8px 10px 6px; border: 2px solid #111417; background: #F5F7F7; color: #111417; border-radius: 0; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #111417; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation link
components.description: Text link; the current page carries a 3px ink underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 22px; font: 600 16px Overpass, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: #111417; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'], .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 3px; text-underline-offset: 7px; }

components.name: Roadbook box
components.description: The signature row: number with caution marks, time and distance, tulip, note with citations; the selected box is swiped marker yellow.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-box { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px 112px minmax(0, 1fr); background: #FFE600; border-bottom: 1px solid #C3C9CC; font-family: Overpass, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; color: #111417; font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1, 'zero' 1; } .ds-box > div { padding: 12px; } .ds-no { font-size: 25px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; } .ds-marks { display: block; color: #C4161C; font-size: 20px; } .ds-td { font-size: 13px; } .ds-td b { font-size: 16px; } .ds-note { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; }

narrative.overview: A drive is a rally roadbook: a numbered run of ruled boxes, each pinned to a time and a distance, each printing the signals that prove it. The whole system is paper and ink. The ground is a cool roll of white paper, every structure is a ruled line, and color appears only as a mark someone made on the page: a red caution mark, a yellow highlighter swipe, a green highlighter swipe. Nothing glows, floats, or rounds off.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper ground, ink structure, color only as marks.
Ruled boxes and hairlines; no radius, no shadow.
Overpass with tabular figures everywhere; DSEG7 digits only in the tripmeter.
Every number points at its evidence: citation chips name source, signal, window, and stat.

rules.name: The Marks Only Rule
rules.body: Red, yellow, and green are marks made on the paper, never surfaces, borders of containers, or decoration. Red means caution; yellow means selected or cited; green means a performance run or lap.

rules.name: The Ink On Green Rule
rules.body: Only tulip ink sits on marker green. Red or gray on green fails AA (3.69:1 and 3.60:1).

rules.name: The Resolved Prints Gray Rule
rules.body: A cleared alert stays in the roadbook, printed in box rule gray, marks included; when it is the selected box, it prints ink on the yellow swipe.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number uses tabular figures and the slashed zero, so columns of times, distances, and values never jitter.

rules.name: The Glance Rule
rules.body: In the live view no text is smaller than 20 arcmin at 1 m (50.2px at 390 wide, 41.8px at 1440 wide) and digits reach 40 arcmin. A value never moves the layout: each digit bank has fixed positions, padded with blank digits.

rules.name: The Units Stay Rule
rules.body: A number and its unit never break across lines.

rules.name: The Ruled Paper Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with lines, never with elevation, blur, or tinted panels.

dos: Do keep the ground roll white (#F5F7F7) on every surface and state, including errors and the live view.
Do cite evidence next to every number: source, signal, window, and stat.
Do keep text to the verified pairs: tulip ink or box rule on roll white, tulip ink or caution red on marker yellow, only tulip ink on marker green.
Do step motion (at most 2 frames, under 100 ms) and remove it under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do theme the browser surfaces: marker yellow selection, ink caret, 3px ink focus ring, box rule scrollbars.
Do print loading, empty, and error states as 1 plain line of text inside the shared frame.
donts: Don't add shadows, radius, gradients, or glow; this world is flat paper.
Don't use caution red for anything but caution and anomaly marks.
Don't put red or gray text on marker green.
Don't use DSEG7 outside the live tripmeter.
Don't use a spinner; loading is a sentence.
Don't set any live-view text below 50.2px at 390 wide or 41.8px at 1440 wide, and never ask for input there.
Don't build cards or card grids; use ruled rows and ruled tables.
